bio: Since 1988, gourmets have been making a beeline for this romantic hideaway, whose old vaults and bare brick walls lend it masses of cachet and bags of elegance. Choose from the daily special or the menu to sample rich authentic food that has earned this eatery its fine reputation. How about a creative spin on a maki with gambas and smoked eel or cod in lemon breadcrumbs jazzed up with seaweed flavoured cabbage stock? The chef knows how to grab our attention and pamper our taste buds. Gloriously sensibly priced and a splendid selection of beers and Bordeaux wines....
